page_title: REN 3-1 LYO | Rennes v Lyon 14/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+9' We are about to witness a substitution. Mahamadou Nagida (Rennes) is replacing Ludovic Blas.
90+5' 3 - 1 Mohamed Meite (Rennes) finds some space inside the box and scores with a terrific header low inside the left post, giving the goalkeeper no chance.
90+3' 2 - 1 It's an own goal! Remy Descamps (Lyon) scores into his own net!
90' We will have 9 min. of added time.
90' None of the defensive players touched the ball. It's going to be a goal kick.
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ruben Kluivert (Lyon) comes onto the pitch for Malick Fofana.
84' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Rennes players have a reason to celebrate!
81' The Rennes players halt their celebrations as referee Ruddy Buquet makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a foul in the build-up play.
79' 1 - 1 Goal! Anthony Rouault (Rennes) slots the ball into an unguarded net from close range after a shot rebounds off a defender. 1:1.
79' Jeremy Jacquet (Rennes) wins himself enough space to meet the resulting corner and fires the ball at goal, but the keeper does well to stop his effort.
79' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Rennes.
75' Tyler Morton (Lyon) is awarded a red card due to his behaviour.
74' Paulo Fonseca has decided to make a change. Pavel Sulc (Lyon) replaces Khalis Merah.
69' A substitution has been made. Djaoui Cisse goes off and Seko Fofana (Rennes) comes on.
69' Mousa Tamari (Rennes) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Lyon will have a goal kick.
69' Rennes earn a corner.
69' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Breel Embolo leaves the pitch and Mohamed Meite (Rennes) comes on.
67' It will be a substitution. Rachid Ghezzal (Lyon) is ready to enter the pitch as Adam Karabec walks off.
64' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Rennes will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
62' A terrific attempt by Djaoui Cisse (Rennes) from the edge of the box slides just narrowly past the right post. The ball goes out of play and Lyon will have a goal kick.
62' Adam Karabec (Lyon) latches onto the ball after a scramble in the box, but his placed effort towards the bottom left corner is far too weak and Brice Samba makes a simple save.
60' Some great controlled play and passing from Lyon. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
56' Malick Fofana (Lyon) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Ruddy Buquet who sees an offensive foul.
56' Rennes string together a series of short passes.
53' Breel Embolo (Rennes) hits a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a comfortable save for Remy Descamps as it's directed low at the middle of the goal.
53' Clinton Mata (Lyon) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
52' Mousa Tamari (Rennes) gets there first and whips in a shot at goal that flies just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lyon.

50' The ball spins to Valentin Rongier (Rennes) on the edge of the box. He hits across the ball and sends it goalwards, but it goes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Lyon will have a goal kick.
49' Jeremy Jacquet (Rennes) tackles a bit over-zealously and Ruddy Buquet blows for a foul.
47' Alidu Seidu (Rennes) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
46' Habib Beye prepares a substitution. Przemyslaw Frankowski is replaced by Mousa Tamari (Rennes).
46' Substitution. Abdelhamid Ait Boudlal makes way for Alidu Seidu (Rennes).
46' Adam Karabec (Lyon) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
46' Ruddy Buquet blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
44' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
43' Now Lyon have a corner.
42' Khalis Merah (Lyon) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom right corner, but Brice Samba pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
42' Khalis Merah (Lyon) gets inside the penalty area and sends a powerful shot that almost ends inside the net. The keeper is alert and makes a good save.
41' The referee points to the corner flag and Rennes will take a corner.
37' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Rennes) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
36' Djaoui Cisse (Rennes) drills in an effort from the edge of the box that climbs rapidly and goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lyon.
34' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
28' Djaoui Cisse (Rennes) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Ruddy Buquet blows his whistle for a foul. Lyon have a free kick from a promising distance.
26' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Rennes) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
26' Rennes hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
22' The linesman points to the corner flag, Rennes are going to take it.
22' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
20' Good work from Lyon as they win a corner.
20' Abner Vinicius (Lyon) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Lyon will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
18' Clinton Mata (Lyon) makes a slide tackle, but referee Ruddy Buquet blows for a foul.

14' 0 - 1 Goal! Ainsley Maitland-Niles plays a neat lofted pass into the box for Corentin Tolisso (Lyon), who beats the defender in the air and plants a header into the bottom right corner from close range. 0:1.
13' Lyon keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
11' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
8' The ball is out of play. Rennes will have a throw-in.
5' Lyon keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
4' The linesman signals a throw-in for Lyon.
1' The match has just started.
Rennes will kick the game off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Ruddy Buquet.
Show lineups Before the start of the game, you can see the starting lineups for today's clash.
Show lineups
